question: In June 2020, a review was published by two authors in Clinical reviews in allergy & immunology regarding the relationship between hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (hEDS), Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS), and Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS).
